items.title: Labs & co-working
items.short: 10,000 sq ft of co-working desks, cubicles, and labs on campus.
items.long: Co-working offices, cubicles, and research labs on the 2nd Floor of the Main Building at IISER Bhopal, with common office equipment and high-speed campus internet.

items.title: Faculty & domain mentoring
items.short: Mentoring from IISER Bhopal faculty and industry experts.
items.long: Incubatees receive domain mentoring from IISER Bhopal faculty across Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Earth Sciences, and EECS as they take a technology towards market.

items.title: Seed & grant funding
items.short: Access to DST NIDHI, BIRAC, and MSME funding pathways.
items.long: TODO_CONFIRM: Proposal guidance and seed support across DST NIDHI-TBI, NIDHI-EIR, BIRAC BIG/EDGE biotechnology grants, and Ministry of MSME schemes.
items._note: Confirm which funding schemes and investor links IICE offers (SRD Q4). The legacy site says that IICE helps with financial matters.

items.title: IP, legal & regulatory
items.short: Patent filing, technology transfer, and compliance support.
items.long: Support with prior-art searches, patent protection, technology transfer from IISER Bhopal labs, company incorporation, and regulatory questions.
items._note: The legacy site supports IP protection, technology transfer and legal help. Regulatory support is unconfirmed.

items.title: Industry & alumni network
items.short: Conclaves, demo days, and strategic R&D partnerships.
items.long: Introductions to corporate R&D leaders, academia, alumni, and the wider startup ecosystem through events such as Industry–Academia Conclave 2.0.

items.title: E-Cell & Startup Studio
items.short: Bootcamps, A-ESDP programmes, and student innovation.
items.long: Workshops, Startup Studio (Lab-to-Market) sessions, Ministry of MSME A-ESDP cohorts, and Innovation Club activities that build entrepreneurial skills.

items.title: BIRAC Edge
items.short: TODO_CONFIRM: Support through the BIRAC EDGE scheme.
items.long: TODO_CONFIRM: Announced at Industry–Academia Conclave 2.0, the BIRAC EDGE scheme supports translational bioscience and healthcare innovators at IICE.
items._note: The BIRAC EDGE scheme was announced at Industry–Academia Conclave 2.0 (8 Aug 2026). Programme details are not yet confirmed (SRD Q6).
